The quadratic factor ${x}^{2}+6$ is irreducible, so we proceed with the following partial fraction decomposition:

$$
\begin{aligned}\frac{-{x}^{2}-7x}{({x}^{2}+6)(x-3)} & =\frac{Ax+B}{{x}^{2}+6}+\frac{C}{x-3}\end{aligned}
$$

To determine the coefficients $A,B,$ and $C,$ we first multiply both sides of the above equation by $({x}^{2}+6)(x-3),$ and we get

$$
\begin{aligned}-{x}^{2}-7x & =(Ax+B)(x-3)+C({x}^{2}+6).\end{aligned}
$$

Solving for the unknown constants using the usual methods, we get $A=1,B=-4,$ and $C=-2.$ Therefore,

$$
\begin{aligned}\frac{-{x}^{2}-7x}{({x}^{2}+6)(x-3)} & =\frac{x-4}{{x}^{2}+6}-\frac{2}{x-3}\end{aligned}
$$

We now integrate this function term by term, adding the constant of integration at the very end.

$$
\begin{aligned}\int \frac{-{x}^{2}-7x}{({x}^{2}+6)(x-3)}\,\text{d}x & =\int (\frac{x-4}{{x}^{2}+6}-\frac{2}{x-3})\text{d}x \\  & =\frac{1}{2}\int \frac{2x}{{x}^{2}+6}\,\text{d}x-4\int \frac{1}{{x}^{2}+6}\,\text{d}x-2\int \frac{1}{x-3}\,\text{d}x\end{aligned}
$$

For the first integral, we use the substitution $u={x}^{2}+6.$ Then $\text{d}u=2x\,\text{d}x,$ and we get

$$
\begin{aligned}\frac{1}{2}\int \frac{2x}{{x}^{2}+6}\,\text{d}x & =\frac{1}{2}\int \frac{1}{u}\text{d}u \\  & =\frac{1}{2}\operatorname{ln}⁡|u| \\  & =\frac{1}{2}\operatorname{ln}⁡|{x}^{2}+6| \\  & =\frac{1}{2}\operatorname{ln}⁡({x}^{2}+6).\end{aligned}
$$

For the second integral, we use the fact that $\int \frac{1}{{x}^{2}+{a}^{2}}\,\text{d}x=\frac{1}{a}\operatorname{arctan}⁡(\frac{x}{a}),$ which results in

$$
\int \frac{1}{{x}^{2}+6}\,\text{d}x=\frac{1}{\sqrt{6}}\operatorname{arctan}⁡(\frac{x}{\sqrt{6}}).
$$

Finally, for the third integral, we have

$$
\int \frac{1}{x-3}\,\text{d}x=\operatorname{ln}⁡|x-3|.
$$

So, we get the following result:

$$
\begin{aligned}\int \frac{-{x}^{2}-7x}{({x}^{2}+6)(x-3)}\,\text{d}x & =\frac{1}{2}\int \frac{2x}{{x}^{2}+6}\,\text{d}x-4\int \frac{1}{{x}^{2}+6}\,\text{d}x-2\int \frac{1}{x-3}\,\text{d}x \\  & =\frac{1}{2}\operatorname{ln}⁡({x}^{2}+6)-\frac{4}{\sqrt{6}}\operatorname{arctan}⁡(\frac{x}{\sqrt{6}})-2\operatorname{ln}⁡|x-3|+K\end{aligned}
$$
